items.name: Merchant's Eye
items.description:
Choose two of the following skills:

Persuasion
Insight
Investigation
History
Eyesight

You gain proficiency in the chosen skills.

If you are already proficient in one of them, you gain Expertise in that skill instead.

items.name: Extensive Network
items.description:
Your connections reach farther than most people realize.

Once per Long Rest, when entering a settlement, you may declare that you possess a business contact in the area.

Work with the DM to determine the nature of the contact.

The contact may provide:

Information
Introductions
Lodging
Transportation
Access to local markets
Business opportunities
Local rumors
Specialized services

The contact is not automatically loyal and may require payment, favors, or assistance before helping you.

items.name: Reputation of Coin
items.description:
Your name carries weight among merchants and traders.

When purchasing mundane goods, lodging, transportation, supplies, tools, crafting materials, or other nonmagical services, prices are reduced by 20% for you and your companions whenever negotiation would reasonably be possible.

Additionally, merchants are generally willing to negotiate with you before refusing a deal outright.

items.name: Golden Opportunity
items.description:
Years of experience have taught you how to recognize opportunities others overlook.

Once per Long Rest, you may ask the DM one of the following questions:

What is the most valuable thing here?
Who has the most influence here?
Who stands to gain the most from this situation?
What opportunity are we overlooking?

The DM must answer truthfully and provide enough information for you to reasonably pursue the lead.

The answer may reveal a profitable venture, influential individual, hidden resource, political advantage, potential ally, valuable information, or another meaningful opportunity.

items.name: Calculated Influence
items.description:
You approach conversation with the same careful analysis you apply to trade, value, and opportunity.

Whenever you make a Charisma ability check, you add your Intelligence modifier to the roll.

items.name: The Golden Ledger
items.description:
Legendary Origin

Some people inherit kingdoms.

Others inherit prophecies, divine blessings, forgotten bloodlines, or ancient secrets.

You inherited opportunity.

Whether you were born into a powerful merchant house, adopted by a trading dynasty, raised among caravans, or simply discovered early in life that you possessed a talent few others shared, one truth became clear long before your first adventure:

You understand value.

Not merely the value of gold, but the value of information, relationships, influence, timing, and trust. While others trained with sword or spell, you learned how deals are made, how fortunes are built, and how entire nations can be influenced by agreements signed behind closed doors.

The greatest merchant houses understand something many rulers never truly grasp.

Gold is not power.
Gold is merely the tool used to acquire it.
The true currency of the world is influence.
A favor owed.
A debt unpaid.
A contact in the right city.
A shipment arriving at the perfect moment.
The ability to place the right person in the right room at exactly the right time.

Over the years you have cultivated a network of relationships that stretches far beyond what most people would expect. Merchants, caravan masters, ship captains, craftsmen, bankers, brokers, nobles, guild officials, and adventurers all form part of a web that continues to expand wherever opportunity exists.

Some people see wealth as a destination.

You see it as a means to something far greater.
